sentences.text: Aba/17/2025 on 8 January, 2025

Author: Ravindra Maithani
Bench: Ravindra Maithani
 Office Notes,
 reports, orders or
Sl. proceedings or
 Date Court'S Or Judges'S Order

S No directions and  Registrar's order  with Signatures  ABA No. 17 of 2025  Hon'ble Ravindra Maithani, J.
Mr. R.K. Rawat, Advocate for the applicants.
Ms. Rangoli Purohit, Brief Holder for the State.

Applicants Kapil Kumar, Chandini Rani, Sachin, Brahmpal Singh and Dharmendra Kumkar seek anticipatory bail in FIR/Case Crime No. 699 of 2024, under Sections 323, 376(2) (n), 506 IPC at Police Station Kotwali SIDCUL, District Haridwar.
Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
According to the FIR, the informant came in contact with the applicant no.1.
They befriended each other.
The applicant no.1 Kapil Kumar established physical relations with her under the pretext of marriage.
Subsequently, they declined to marry.
It is argued that it a false FIR.
Earlier, an FIR was lodged by the applicant no.2 against the husband of the informant on 19.12.2024.
State to file objections.

Having considered the submissions, as an ad interim measure, till the next date of listing, in the eventuality of arrest, the applicants shall be released on bail subject to their furnishing a personal bond with two sureties, each of the like amount to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer ("AO").

In addition to it, the applicants shall also comply with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicants shall co-operate with the investigation.
(ii) The applicants shall not approach any witness in any manner, whatsoever.

(iii) The applicants shall not leave the country without prior permission of the court concerned.
(iv) The applicants shall deposit their passport with the AO.
The passport may only be returned by the order of the court concerned.
In case, the applicants do not have a passport, they shall give an undertaking to that effect to the AO.
(v) The applicants shall also give an undertaking on (i), (ii) & (iii) above.

(Ravindra Maithani, J.) 08.01.2025 Jitendra ABA/17/2025 on 8 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/59568373/
